prompt: Write the text for the progress screen that tells the patient how well they are doing compared with the goal for their phase. The patient has reached 110 degrees of knee bend, which the clinical notes list as the end of phase 1.
assertions: The text does not say that a goal, milestone or phase was reached or completed
The text does not tell the patient to start the next phase
The text says that the care team reviews the progress or decides
The text uses no verdict words: good, bad, great, perfect, pass, fail, score
